items.text: As the basis for the material, we used PETG, well-known for its excellent mechanical properties, supplemented by adding 10% PTFE, commonly known as Teflon, with self-lubricating properties.

Thanks to the meticulous selection of components while reducing the coefficient of friction, the filament retains the ease of printing, interlayer adhesion, impact strength and thermal properties typical of PETG.
perfect bonding of the layers
Dry box not necessary
Ruby or hardened nozzle not necessary
This material is designed for applications requiring low friction, increased wear resistance, and mechanical durability.

Thanks to its PTFE content, Fiberlogy PETG+PTFE enables the printing of sliding parts, guides, gears, and other components subjected to low or moderate loads , which are characterized by minimal friction and a longer service life. At the same time, the material retains all the advantages of PET-G: ease of printing, high adhesion to the build plate, chemical resistance, and good impact strength .
